items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: And you had Charlie Rice and Skeeter Best... Charlie, yeah.

ctx.x: And you had Charlie Rice and Skeeter Best...

Charlie, yeah. Well, Skeeter was a good guitarist. I don't know why now he ain't too playing too good. He's getting over or something. They say he ain't playing right. I don't know. I haven't heard him lately.
